text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ONCALL PAGE: GPU queue growth detected in us-west-2 - autoscaler not responding (threshold: 1200 queued requests). Please acknowledge. https://redwood/internal/runbooks/autoscale-pager

maria: acked. seeing queue up from 300 -> 1400 in last 12m, 99th p99 latency for gen endpoints spiking to 6s. Customers reporting 429s.

raj: oncall here. grabbing logs. starting triage. any active deploys?

oliver: no deploys. CI shows no scaleup events in the autoscaler logs since 10:12 UTC. provider reports API quota 429 on scale requests.

maria: exact error from controller: `providerapi: error 429: quota_exceeded - attempted create 8 nodes`

raj: that matches. looks like cloud vendor hit per-minute external quota. autoscaler retried but backed off. queue kept growing.

kim: can we enable reserved spare pool for critical customers? which pools are healthy?

jordan: eu pool healthy, us-east has spare_gpus:2 but not in us-west. we can try live-eviction of best-effort workloads in us-west to free slots.

maria: initiating best-effort eviction policy script now: ```bash
# evict lower-priority jobs in us-west
kubectl label pods -n workloads priority=best-effort eviction=now --selector=tenant_profile=nonpaying
```

oncall-ops-bot: Eviction job launched (job id: evict-7991). Progress: 0/42 pods terminated.

oliver: also opening manual scale request with provider support - adding a request to increase per-minute quota. pinging cloud-support@vendor.

raj: rolling temporary throttle on new incoming requests for non-SLAs to reduce tail. config change: rate_limit.route=/generate limit=40rps -> 20rps. applying now.

maria: throttle applied. incoming QPS dropped ~30% and queue growth slowed. customers with reserved dedicated capacity unaffected.

noncall-ops-bot: Eviction job update: 20/42 pods terminated; reclaimed 4 GPUs. Scheduler placed 3 pending gen requests onto reclaimed GPUs, latency improved.

oliver: autoscaler still failing to create nodes due to 429s. provider acknowledged throttling and escalated; ETA for quota bump ~25m.

kim: can we shift some traffic to eu region for affected customers? we have cross-region fallback for chat-gen but need to patch routing policy for a subset.

jordan: will prepare a targeted routing rule for tenants: `route.override(tenant=alpha): region=eu-west-1` and only for non-low-latency SLAs. prepping PR to console now.

raj: working with infra to set emergency capacity policy: allow temporary oversubscribe of shared pool by 10% to absorb burst. This requires operator approval.

maria: operator approved. bumped oversubscribe to 10%. reclaimed slots allocated to critical queues.

noncall-ops-bot: Eviction complete. reclaimed total 8 GPUs. Current queued requests: 320. p95 latency back to 1.2s.

oliver: provider confirmed quota increase at +2 nodes, but their autoscale request backlog still being processed. manual scale in progress: `providerctl create-nodes --region us-west-2 --count 2 --type gpu-v100` executed.

raj: manual nodes entered preboot; expect ready in ~7m. queue continuing to drain. monitoring for regressions.

maria: customer impact note: ~15 tenants experienced degraded performance (increased latency or temporary 429) for ~26 minutes. Top impacted tenant: acme-inc — they saw ~3% failed requests. We've sent a customer update.

kim: good. please create incident ticket and set Sev2. Also start postmortem template: link https://redwood/internal/postmortems/new

jordan: created `INC-7991234` and assigned initial owner to maria. Postmortem draft started.

raj: immediate action items:
- (raj) Add circuit-breaker to autoscaler to stop retrying on vendor 429 and switch to fallback policy sooner. due EOD
- (oliver) Add telemetry alert for provider API 429s so we catch quota thrashes earlier. due next week
- (maria) Expand reserved spare pool in us-west by +4 GPUs for night windows (0-8 UTC) as a temporary mitigation. due in 48h
- (kim) Update routing fallback docs and create a runbook step to shift non-critical tenants to other regions. due 72h
- (jordan) Postmortem writeup + customer impact summary. due 48h

maria: note: we should not rely on manual eviction as primary mitigation. plan is to harden autoscaler fallback path and provider quota observability.

noncall-ops-bot: Incident resolved: queue under control, p95 latency stable, emergency throttles removed at 7991234987.

raj: closing this thread. will follow up in postmortem with timeline + logs + playbook changes. thanks all. :raised_hands:

maria: thanks. great coordination.

kim: tagging product for customer comms: @product-ops

jordan: leaving the incident ticket open until postmortem complete.
